name: Jhana Grove Retreat Centre

location.address: Adjacent Bodhinyana Monastery, Serpentine WA 6125, Australia

tradition: Theravada Buddhism / Insight Meditation (Buddhist Society of Western Australia)
technique: Silent sitting and walking meditation (the Basic Method of Meditation taught by Ajahn Brahm) with a strong emphasis on stillness and letting go, supported by daily teaching, personal interviews, and long hours of solitary practice.
teacherAccess: 3-4 hours of daily teaching, personal interviews (via an interview roster on 9-day retreats), and guided meditation from BSWA teachers including Ajahn Brahm.
retreatOptions: BSWA weekend (3-day) retreats functioning as an introduction to meditation, and longer 5-day and 9-day silent retreats for more experienced meditators; self-retreats and group self-retreats are also available between scheduled programs.
about: Jhana Grove is a purpose-built meditation retreat centre in a valley of the Darling Scarp adjacent to Bodhinyana Monastery in Serpentine, run by the Buddhist Society of Western Australia (BSWA). It can house up to 60 guests at a time across ten cottages of six ensuite rooms each, connected by a covered walkway to a large air-conditioned meditation hall with adjoining halls for walking meditation, plus a dedicated kitchen and dining area. BSWA retreats at Jhana Grove range from 3-day weekend retreats (which can serve as an introduction to meditation) to 5-day and 9-day silent retreats for more experienced practitioners, built around many hours of daily sitting and walking meditation interspersed with teaching and personal interviews, under Noble Silence and the 8 precepts. Retreatants must be 18 or older and BSWA members, and 9-day retreats require prior retreat experience.
schedule: Retreat days are built around long periods of sitting and walking meditation interrupted only by 3-4 hours of daily teaching, personal interviews, and vegetarian meals (light breakfast, lunch, and evening tea); Noble Silence and the 8 precepts are observed throughout.
cost: A refundable room bond is charged per retreat, which retreatants may choose to donate: $300 for 9-day retreats, $180 for 5-day retreats, and $120 for weekend retreats; self-retreatants are asked to donate around $30 per person per day toward the centre's upkeep.

pricePerDay.notes: Derived from the published $300 refundable bond for a 9-night retreat (~$33/night) and the ~$30/person/day suggested donation for self-retreats; retreats themselves are otherwise donation-based, with the bond returnable as a donation.

foodNotes: Vegetarian meals are provided (light breakfast, lunch, and an evening drink, with a light evening meal sometimes served on weekend retreats), largely from donated food.
workNotes: Retreatants are asked to help with jobs such as cleaning cottages and common areas during and at the end of the retreat.
